# Commands

A structured workflow for coding agents: grill → ticket/spec → breakdown → TDD in a sandbox → review → PR.

## `agentic new [idea]`

A new flow from your own idea: business grill → ticket → … → ready to publish.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `idea` | a short description of the idea (the slug comes from it); without it you paste a longer description in the terminal |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--autonomy <preset>` | gate preset (saved in the flow; resume remembers it) (`strict`, `standard`, `autopilot`, `custom`) |
| `--fake` | fake harness (no tokens), for trials and demos |
| `--base <branch>` | the PR's target branch: the flow starts from its state on origin; defaults to origin's default branch |

## `agentic pick [ticket]`

A flow from a ready ticket (markdown with ACs, from a file or pasted); starts at the technical grill. Pulling from a tracker is planned.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `ticket` | path to ticket.md; without it you paste the ticket in the terminal |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--autonomy <preset>` | gate preset (saved in the flow; resume remembers it) (`strict`, `standard`, `autopilot`, `custom`) |
| `--fake` | fake harness (no tokens), for trials and demos |
| `--new` | a new flow, even when this ticket has a paused one |
| `--base <branch>` | the PR's target branch: the flow starts from its state on origin; defaults to origin's default branch |

## `agentic resume [slug]`

Resumes a paused flow where it stopped (with the gate preset saved in the flow).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `slug` | the flow's slug; without it you pick from this repo's paused flows |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--autonomy <preset>` | gate preset (saved in the flow; resume remembers it) (`strict`, `standard`, `autopilot`, `custom`) |
| `--fake` | fake harness (no tokens), for trials and demos |

## `agentic status [slug]`

Lists flows, or details of one (stages, groups, pause, usage).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `slug` | the flow's slug |

## `agentic publish [slug]`

Publishes a finished flow: secret scan (gitleaks) → push of a branch named by `git.branch_pattern` → PR/MR through the profile's forge (`none`: a link to create it) → cleanup of work branches and clones. With `publish.stack` a chain of groups becomes a stack: a PR per group on the previous one's branch, the lowest ready, the rest as drafts. Running it again updates the same PRs.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `slug` | the flow's slug; without it you pick from this repo's finished flows |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--base <branch>` | the PR's target branch; defaults to the one chosen at the flow's start (another one: rebase onto it before the push) |
| `--single` | one PR for everything instead of a stack of PRs (this once, like `publish.stack: false`) |
| `--yes` | no confirmation prompt |

## `agentic restack <slug>`

Rebuilds a published stack of PRs: PR state from the forge; after the lowest ones merge (squash too) the rest moves onto the target (`rebase --onto`), after human commits in a lower PR the higher ones are rebuilt on them. `review.checks` after each branch; a conflict → a merge session and the merge gate. Then `push --force-with-lease` (after confirmation), the new lowest PR retargeted and out of draft, stack lists in the descriptions. Interrupted (a gate, manual resolution): running it again continues.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `slug` | the published flow's slug |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--yes` | no confirmation prompt before the force-push |

## `agentic clean [slug]`

Cleans up what flows leave behind: work directories (clones, bundles, check logs, transcripts), hidden rollback refs and `agentic/<slug>/*` branches. Audit artifacts (ticket, spec, tasks, review reports, usage, events) stay. A branch with commits that exist nowhere else (another branch, a tag, a remote) goes only after confirmation.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `slug` | one flow, a paused one too, which then ends; without it: this repo's finished flows and flow branches whose directory is gone |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | only show what would go and how much space it takes |
| `--yes` | no prompt; branches holding the only copy of work stay |

## `agentic usage <slug>`

A flow's tokens and cost broken down: stage → group → task / review round / fix.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `slug` | the flow's slug |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--by <dimension>` | a flat breakdown by one dimension (`kind`, `model`, `stage`, `group`, `task`) |
| `--json` | output as JSON |

## `agentic doctor`

Checks the environment: config, profile, harness CLIs, Docker, the framework version, and in a service repo also what `agentic init` shows at the end. Changes nothing.

## `agentic init`

Prepares a service repo: `.agentic/config.yaml` with `review.checks` of the detected build (Gradle, Maven, npm) and a ticket template, and adds an `## Agentic` section to an existing `AGENTS.md`. Shows and asks before writing; overwrites nothing. At the end (also on a rerun) shows what the repo has for agents: a context map, `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`, the `architecture.md` / `testing.md` / `code.md` standards, and what to make the rest with.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--yes` | write without asking (e.g. without a terminal) |

## `agentic setup`

Prepares the environment with your consent: Podman for container sessions (install through brew, a machine on macOS) and (once) a dictation app.

## `agentic sandbox build`

Builds session images with the `sandbox.engine` engine: the base (`agentic/base`: git, Claude Code, Codex, Node) and this repo's stack layer (`sandbox.image.stack`, e.g. `agentic/jvm` with JDK 17/21/25). After a framework update `doctor` suggests a rebuild. At the end removes replaced framework images, and with Podman on macOS returns the freed space from the virtual machine's disk.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--stack <stack>` | the stack layer to build instead of the one detected in the repo (jvm) |

## `agentic sandbox clean`

Removes session containers and networks left by an `agentic` process that is gone (crash, SIGKILL); a running flow's sessions are left alone. `--caches` also removes the dependency cache volumes.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--caches` | also remove the `agentic-cache-*` volumes (the next build downloads dependencies again) |

## `agentic skills list`

The framework's skills and where they are installed.

## `agentic skills install`

Links the practices into `~/.claude/skills` (Claude Code) and `~/.agents/skills` (Codex). Idempotent; leaves a file or directory with the same name alone.

## `agentic skills uninstall`

Removes the links to this framework's skills; nothing else.

## `agentic config show`

The merged config (all layers + profile) as YAML.

## `agentic models`

The framework's model catalog (alias → harness, ID, efforts).
